text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, maybe I should take it 
easy and get some rest today...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"No way, she's absent!? We're on cleaning 
duty today, think the two of us can 
manage?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No point complaining. It'll take time, but 
we just gotta do it ourselves, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (Ah, and here my friend is in trouble...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I have to help her... But would doing 
this only be a nuisance...?!)

Victoire Pisa agonized so much over 
whether to help out that her headache only 
grew worse.
